title: Delivery Manager
description:

title: People Advisory Consultant
description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.


Working with people in over 200 countries and territories, we are on the ground in more than 100 countries.


**We connect. We inspire.**

**The Role**The People Advisory Consultant will provide expert, short\-term People Function support to the rapidly growing Shared Services Centre in Noida, addressing immediate HR and employee relations priorities. The role will provide practical, risk\-based advice on complex people matters, support senior stakeholders and managers, and strengthen leadership, management capability and organisational culture.  

The role will also assess the longer\-term People Function requirements of the Shared Services Centre and provide evidence\-based recommendations on the future service model, capability, capacity and resources needed. Reporting to the Head of APAC People Solutions, the consultant will work closely with SSC leadership, managers, People Function and global specialist teams to stabilise current priorities while designing sustainable support for continued growth.  

**Main responsibilities**The People Advisory Consultant will provide expert HR and employee relations advice on complex, sensitive and high\-risk matters, assessing priorities, risks and required actions. The role will support managers and senior stakeholders with fair, consistent and timely solutions, ensuring alignment with organisational policies, employment requirements and risk considerations. It will also identify recurring issues, cultural and management capability gaps, and provide practical recommendations to strengthen leadership and people management.  

The role will assess the current and future People Function requirements of the Shared Services Centre, developing evidence\-based recommendations on service model, capability, capacity, resourcing and associated costs. It will work closely with People Partners, Employee Relations, specialist teams and SSC leadership to establish priorities, clarify accountability and develop an implementation plan for sustainable support.  

The consultant will bring together people data, stakeholder insight and case experience to identify themes and underlying causes, translating findings into clear, prioritised actions. The role will monitor progress, highlight emerging risks and provide senior stakeholders with clear recommendations to support immediate interventions and longer\-term People Function planning.  

**Role specific skills*** Employee Relations and Risk Management
* Provides expert advice on complex employee relations matters.
* Balances organisational, employee and legal considerations when making recommendations.
* Identifies and mitigates people\-related risks.
* Business Acumen and Organisational Insight
* Understands organisational priorities and translating people issues into practical solutions.
* Assesses organisational capability, capacity and future people requirements.
* Use evidence and insight to inform recommendations and decision\-making.
  

**Role specific knowledge and experience****Minimum/essential**Experience of:
* Minimum 10 years of experience in HR and Employee Relations, gained within a global organisation operating in a matrix structure.

* Organisational, leadership or management capability issues and recommending solutions.

**Language Requirements*** The British Council systems and global processes operate in English. Written and verbal proficiency in English is required.

title: Head of IT and Business Operations
description:
**Head of IT \& Business Operations**

**Solutionara Private Limited**  
**Location:** Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time, Permanent  
**Work Arrangement:** On\-Site  
**Experience:** 12–18\+ Years

**About Solutionara**

Solutionara is an **AI\-led IT Consulting and Technology Services organization** delivering enterprise transformation, cloud modernization, integration solutions, data platforms, and digital engineering services to global clients.

Headquartered in the United States with a Global Delivery Center (GDC) in Noida, we are building an automation\-first, AI\-enabled operating and delivery model where cloud infrastructure, operational excellence, and intelligent workflows support both client delivery and organizational growth.

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced **Head of IT \& Business Operations** to lead technology operations, cloud and DevOps practices, internal IT infrastructure, workplace technology, and business operations for our Noida Global Delivery Center.

This is a **hands\-on leadership role** for someone who can combine technology strategy with execution. You will be expected to strengthen AWS and DevOps operations, improve infrastructure reliability and security, drive automation, manage internal IT services, and ensure the GDC operates efficiently as Solutionara continues to scale.

The ideal candidate has strong experience across **AWS, DevOps, infrastructure/platform operations and enterprise IT**, while also being comfortable owning vendors, procurement, facilities, operational governance, and cross\-functional business operations.

Key Responsibilities

**Cloud, DevOps \& Infrastructure**

* Lead AWS cloud operations and DevOps practices across internal and client\-facing environments.
* Establish scalable, secure, and reliable cloud infrastructure standards.
* Drive Infrastructure as Code using **Terraform** and related technologies.
* Establish CI/CD, deployment, release, and environment\-management practices.
* Lead containerized environments using **Docker and Kubernetes**.
* Strengthen monitoring, observability, incident management, backup, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
* Drive cloud cost optimization, capacity planning, and FinOps practices.
* Support enterprise cloud transformation and modernization initiatives.
* Advance **AI\-assisted DevOps, AIOps, and automation\-first operations**.

**IT Operations \& Security**

* Own internal IT operations for the Noida GDC.
* Oversee endpoint management, devices, software licensing, IT assets, networking, Wi\-Fi, and workplace technology.
* Manage employee technology onboarding and offboarding.
* Strengthen IAM, cloud security, vulnerability management, access controls, and technology governance.
* Establish effective IT support processes and service standards.

**Business Operations**

* Oversee day\-to\-day operational readiness of the Noida Global Delivery Center.
* Coordinate facilities, workplace services, administration, and business continuity.
* Develop scalable operational processes, controls, and governance.
* Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work through automation and process improvement.
* Build operational dashboards, KPIs, and management reporting.

**Vendor Management \& Procurement**

* Manage technology, cloud, facilities, and operational vendors.
* Oversee contracts, renewals, procurement, assets, and inventory.
* Monitor vendor performance and identify opportunities for cost optimization and consolidation.

**Leadership**

* Partner directly with executive leadership on technology and operational priorities.
* Collaborate across Engineering, Delivery, Integration, HR, Finance, and Client Services.
* Lead and mentor technology and operations team members.
* Build accountability, operational discipline, and a strong ownership culture.

These responsibilities reflect the broad technology, operations, vendor, automation and leadership ownership defined for the position.

**What We're Looking For**

* **12–18\+ years** of experience across Cloud Operations, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, IT Operations, Technology Management, or related areas.
* **5\+ years in a technology leadership role** involving cloud infrastructure, DevOps, platform operations, or enterprise IT.
* Strong hands\-on understanding of **AWS** and enterprise cloud environments.
* Strong experience with **Terraform / Infrastructure as Code**.
* Experience with **CI/CD** technologies such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or GitLab.
* Experience with **Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized environments**.
* Knowledge of cloud networking, IAM, security, monitoring, observability, backup, and disaster recovery.
* Experience managing internal IT operations, infrastructure, endpoints, assets, or workplace technology.
* Experience with vendors, procurement, operational governance, and cost management.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Ability to operate effectively in a **fast\-paced, growing technology consulting environment**.
* Willingness to remain close to execution and step in hands\-on when required.

The underlying role specification similarly requires substantial AWS/DevOps technical depth alongside operational leadership rather than executive management alone.

**Preferred**

* AWS Professional or Specialty certification.
* Consulting, managed services, or technology services experience.
* Experience supporting U.S.\-based clients or global delivery teams.
* Exposure to **AIOps, AI\-assisted operations, and intelligent automation**.
* Familiarity with ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar security/governance frameworks.
* Experience supporting enterprise cloud transformation programs.

**What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means building a secure and scalable technology and operational foundation for Solutionara—reliable AWS environments, mature DevOps and IaC practices, effective internal IT operations, stronger automation, disciplined governance, and a GDC operating model capable of supporting continued growth.

**Work Location**

This is a **full\-time, on\-site leadership position based at Solutionara's Global Delivery Center in Sector 62, Noida**.

This is **not a remote position**. Candidates should apply only if they are comfortable working regularly from our Noida office.

title: HR Executive - L2
description:
**Position:** HR Operations Executive / Senior Executive**Department:** Human Resources**Location:** Noida / Gurugram**Experience:** 5–7 years**Reporting To:** VP – HR**About the Role**
------------------


We are looking for an experienced **HR Operations professional** to manage and strengthen day\-to\-day HR operations, employee records, HR systems, payroll coordination, attendance and leave administration, statutory compliance, and HR process governance.
The role requires strong attention to detail, ownership of HR data and systems, and the ability to independently manage operational processes while ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and timely closure.**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1\. HR Operations \& Employee Lifecycle**

* Manage day\-to\-day HR operations across the complete employee lifecycle, from onboarding to separation.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date employee records, documentation, and HR databases.
* Manage employee master data, changes in employment details, transfers, reporting changes, designations, departments, and other HR transactions.
* Ensure timely completion of joining, confirmation, transfer, promotion, separation, and exit\-related documentation.

### **2\. HRMS \& Systems Management**

* Administer and maintain **Keka and other HR systems**, including employee data, workflows, settings, access controls, attendance, leave, and related configurations.
* Ensure data accuracy and consistency across HR systems.
* Manage HR system access, user creation/deactivation, and employee master\-data changes.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive HR processes and improve operational efficiency.

### **3\. Payroll \& Attendance**

* Coordinate and support the monthly payroll process, ensuring accurate and timely payroll inputs.
* Validate attendance, leave, work hours, regularization, WFH, deductions, incentives, and other payroll\-related inputs.
* Coordinate with Finance/payroll partners for payroll processing and resolution of discrepancies.
* Conduct periodic audits of attendance and HR data and ensure timely closure of exceptions.

### **4\. Leave, Attendance \& Workstatus Administration**

* Manage leave and attendance policies and ensure proper system implementation.
* Monitor attendance, effective working hours, regularization, and related exceptions.
* Coordinate with managers and employees for resolution of attendance and leave discrepancies.
* Maintain operational reports and dashboards for attendance and workforce\-related metrics.

### **5\. Statutory Compliance \& Documentation**

* Support and coordinate statutory HR compliance requirements applicable to the organization.
* Maintain statutory records, registers, employee documentation, and compliance\-related data.
* Coordinate with external consultants, payroll partners, and relevant authorities wherever required.
* Ensure HR documentation is complete, accurate, and audit\-ready.

### **6\. HR Reporting \& Data Management**

* Prepare regular HR Operations reports covering headcount, joining/exits, attendance, leave, payroll inputs, employee movements, and other operational metrics.
* Maintain accurate HR MIS and dashboards.
* Analyse HR operational data and highlight discrepancies, trends, and areas requiring corrective action.
* Ensure timely submission of reports to HR leadership and other stakeholders.

### **7\. Process \& Governance**

* Develop, implement, and maintain HR Operations SOPs, checklists, and controls.
* Ensure adherence to approved HR policies and processes.
* Identify process gaps and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain proper documentation and audit trails for HR transactions.
* Work closely with HR, Finance, IT, and business teams to resolve operational issues.

**Required Skills \& Experience**
---------------------------------

* 5–7 years of relevant experience in **HR Operations / HR Shared Services / HR Administration**.
* Strong hands\-on experience with **HRMS/HRIS**, preferably Keka or similar platforms.
* Good understanding of payroll inputs, attendance, leave administration, employee lifecycle processes, and statutory compliance.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and ability to work with HR MIS and data.
* High attention to detail and strong data accuracy.
* Good understanding of HR policies, processes, and documentation.
* Ability to independently manage multiple HR operational processes and deadlines.
* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality of employee and payroll information.

**Preferred**
-------------

* Experience in an **IT / Software Services organization**.
* Experience managing HRMS configurations and workflows.
* Experience in HR process automation and operational reporting.
* Experience coordinating with payroll vendors, Finance, and statutory consultants.
* Strong working knowledge of advanced Excel functions and HR dashboards.

description:
**Training \& Development Lead**

**Location:** Noida

**Department:** Human Resources / Quality \& Operations

**Reports To:** HR Manager / dotted line reporting to Head of Quality (QMS)

**Job Purpose**

The Training \& Development Lead is responsible for designing, implementing, and governing an end\-to\-end employee learning framework using the ADDIE model. This role bridges general HR/organizational development and technical competency mapping, ensuring all training processes comply with **ISO 9001:2015 (Clause 7\.2 \- Competence)** standards.

**Key Roles \& Responsibilities**

**1\. End\-to\-End Training Management (ADDIE Model)**

· **Analysis:** Conduct organization\-wide Training Needs Analysis (TNA) across general, HR, soft\-skills, and technical product/process domains.

· **Design \& Development:** Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to build structured training modules, SOPs, and On\-the\-Job Training (OJT) frameworks.

· **Implementation:** Schedule, coordinate, and facilitate both internal technical deep\-dives and external certification programs.

· **Evaluation:** Measure training effectiveness post\-30/60 days via performance data, manager sign\-offs, and skill evaluations.

**2\. QMS \& ISO 9001 Governance**

· Maintain and update the organization’s **Training SOP** and centralized QMS documentation.

· Maintain auditor\-ready records, including Skills Matrices, signed attendance logs, training plans, and effectiveness sign\-offs.

· Lead internal and external audit readiness for Clause 7\.2 (Competence, Training, and Awareness).

**3\. Technical \& Operational Competency Mapping**

· Partner with engineering, firmware, hardware, and assembly leads to map technical roles to required skill levels.

· Formalize peer review mechanisms, OJT sign\-offs, and high\-voltage/lab safety training logs.

**4\. Metrics \& Reporting**

· Track Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Training Completion Rate (\>90%), Training Effectiveness Rate (\>85%), and Skill Gap Reduction.

· Present quarterly training metrics and compliance reports to management during Management Review Meetings (MRM).

**Qualifications \& Key Requirements**

· **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

· **Experience:** 4–7 years of experience in Learning \& Development (L\&D) or Training, ideally within engineering, electronics, automotive, or tech manufacturing startups.

title: Placement Co-ordinator
description:
Job Description: Placement Coordinator Company: Pregrad Position: Placement Coordinator Location: On\-site Employment Type: Full\-Time / Internship Experience: Freshers are welcome About Pregrad Pregrad is an industry\-focused learning and career development platform helping students and young professionals become industry\-ready through practical learning, live mentorship, projects, training programs, and placement opportunities. We work closely with students, colleges, training partners, mentors, and companies to create meaningful career opportunities for the next generation of professionals. Role Overview We are looking for a Placement Coordinator who will be responsible for coordinating and managing placement activities between students, colleges, and hiring companies. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication and coordination skills, be comfortable interacting with students and corporate representatives, and have a strong interest in campus placements, recruitment, and career development. Key Responsibilities \- Coordinate placement drives, recruitment processes, and hiring activities with colleges and students. \- Act as a point of contact between Pregrad, colleges, students, HR teams, and hiring companies. \- Communicate job openings, eligibility criteria, interview schedules, assessments, and selection updates to students. \- Coordinate with college placement cells and Training \& Placement Officers (TPOs). \- Maintain and regularly update student and candidate databases. \- Shortlist and coordinate candidates based on company requirements and eligibility criteria. \- Schedule assessments, interviews, group discussions, and other recruitment activities. \- Ensure smooth execution of online and offline placement drives. \- Follow up with candidates and companies throughout the recruitment process. \- Maintain accurate records of applications, attendance, selections, offers, and joining status. \- Prepare regular placement reports and status updates. \- Support the business/partnership team in developing relationships with colleges and companies. \- Identify opportunities to improve student participation and placement outcomes. \- Handle student queries and provide timely updates regarding placement activities. Required Skills \- Excellent verbal and written communication skills. \- Strong coordination and follow\-up abilities. \- Good interpersonal and relationship\-management skills. \- Proficiency in Google Sheets/Excel and basic documentation. \- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines simultaneously. \- Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills. \- Professional communication with students, colleges, and corporate stakeholders. \- Ability to work independently as well as within a team. Preferred Qualifications \- Bachelor's degree in any discipline. \- Candidates with experience in placement coordination, HR, recruitment, business development, campus relations, or student engagement will be preferred. \- Freshers with strong communication and coordination skills are encouraged to apply. What You'll Get at Pregrad \- Hands\-on experience in campus recruitment and talent acquisition. \- Exposure to companies, HR professionals, colleges, and senior stakeholders. \- Opportunity to work in a fast\-paced EdTech \& CareerTech environment. \- Direct involvement in building and executing placement programs. \- Opportunity to develop strong professional, communication, and relationship\-management skills. \- Growth opportunities based on performance. Ideal Candidate We are looking for someone who is proactive, responsible, energetic, and highly organized. If you enjoy interacting with people, building relationships, coordinating teams, and helping students discover career opportunities, this role could be a great fit for you.
